- [RLOW.13.12] **Compile-time validation is strict.** Every
  name must resolve, every type must match, every
  form must be gate-enabled, every structural
  invariant must hold. The service set is fixed at compile time and
  carried in the `.dsc`, so nothing arrives later to
  validate against ([RARC.9.4.2]). Restates [RLOW.1.4] and [RLOW.11.6].
